strategy.thesis: Corporate venture arm of Royal Philips making early- to growth-stage investments in health technology start-ups (digital health, diagnostics, connected/monitoring devices) that strategically align with Philips' healthcare businesses, pairing capital with regulatory, clinical and commercialization support.

summary.en: Philips Ventures is Royal Philips' corporate venture arm, investing $2–5M initial checks in early- to growth-stage health-technology start-ups across digital health, diagnostics and connected care that strategically complement Philips' medtech businesses.

sources.title: Philips Ventures
sources.quote: At Philips Ventures, we collaborate with health technology start-ups that share our passion to improve outcomes, reduce costs and transform the healthcare experience for patients and clinicians. We specialize in early- and growth-stage investments in healthcare technology companies addressing unmet needs that align with Philips' businesses.

sources.title: Philips Health Technology Ventures | Investor Profile
sources.quote: offering initial investments ranging from $2 million to $5 million USD, targeting companies at the Series A/B stage

strategy.thesis: In-house venture-building unit of B. Braun (Germany) developing sensor-, robotics- and AI-enabled solutions to automate medical procedures (surgical navigation, digital surgery, medical robotics) across B. Braun's device businesses; runs alongside B. Braun's separate 'Corporate Investment and Collaborations' program, which makes direct equity investments in external medtech start-ups.

summary.en: B. Braun New Ventures is B. Braun's Freiburg-based corporate venture-building unit creating sensor-, robotics- and AI-driven medical-procedure-automation ventures, sitting alongside B. Braun's wider corporate investment and collaboration activity with external medtech start-ups.

sources.title: B. Braun New Ventures
sources.quote: B. Braun New Ventures was founded in 2020

sources.title: Corporate Investment and Collaborations
sources.supports: broader CVC-style investing beyond New Ventures unit
sources.quote: Through strategic capital investments in startups, B. Braun seeks to expand its product portfolio and strengthen its competitive position, with a focus on startups that complement and expand its leading device-based ecosystems.

verification_notes: B. Braun New Ventures is primarily an internal venture-building/innovation unit (robotics, digital surgery, medical automation) rather than a pure external-startup investment fund; B. Braun's direct equity investing in outside medtech start-ups runs through a separate 'Corporate Investment and Collaborations' program referenced on B. Braun's main site. Included as a known anchor for this slice; treated as a hybrid CVC/venture-studio entity.

strategy.thesis: Corporate venture and business-development arm of Siemens Healthineers, combining strategic venture investing with an M&A pipeline and a Silicon Valley 'Digital Incubator' to back start-ups in medical imaging, diagnostics and digital-health services that extend Siemens Healthineers' precision-medicine portfolio.

summary.en: Siemens Healthineers' Ventures & Business Development team pairs strategic venture investing with M&A and a Silicon Valley Digital Incubator to back imaging, diagnostics and digital-health start-ups relevant to Siemens Healthineers' business units.

sources.title: VC Vice President @ Siemens Healthineers in Mountain View, CA
sources.supports: team name, mandate (M&A pipeline + strategic VC investing)
sources.quote: Ventures and Business Development Team focuses on the inorganic growth of the global portfolio by developing the M&A pipeline and by strategic venture capital investing.

verification_notes: No single official public 'Ventures' landing page with full portfolio disclosure was found; existence and mandate confirmed via Siemens Healthineers innovation pages and Ventures & Business Development careers postings, plus a cited investment in ScreenPoint Medical.

strategy.thesis: Corporate venture arm of Fresenius Medical Care investing from seed to later stage in medical devices, digital health and healthcare-services companies relevant to chronic kidney disease, dialysis, intensive-care medicine and cardiovascular disease.

summary.en: Fresenius Medical Care Ventures (est. 2016, Bad Homburg) is the corporate venture arm of dialysis and renal-care group Fresenius Medical Care, investing seed-to-growth in medical devices, digital health and services tied to chronic kidney disease, dialysis and cardiovascular care.

sources.title: Ventures | Fresenius Medical Care
sources.quote: Fresenius Medical Care Ventures (FMCV) invests in start-ups and early-stage companies in the healthcare sector.

sources.title: Fresenius Medical Care Ventures Portfolio Investments
sources.quote: Fresenius Medical Care Ventures has made 15 investments, with their latest investment in eGenesis as part of their Series D on September 04, 2024.

strategy.thesis: Corporate venture capital arm of Werfen, a Spanish specialized-diagnostics group, investing globally in diagnostics start-ups plus adjacent life-science tools and digital solutions; an evergreen fund targeting 15–20 portfolio companies over time.

summary.en: We Venture Capital is the 2023-launched, Barcelona-based corporate venture arm of diagnostics group Werfen, deploying €1–3M evergreen-fund checks into diagnostics, digital-health and life-science-tools start-ups such as sepsis-diagnostics company Deepull.

sources.title: We Venture Capital – Investing globally in diagnostics start-ups
sources.quote: Investing globally in diagnostics start-ups, as well as digital solutions and life science tools disrupting the diagnostics arena. We are the corporate venture arm of Werfen, a worldwide leader in Specialized Diagnostics.

sources.title: Medical diagnostics firm Werfen launches CVC
sources.supports: founding year, check size, stage, target portfolio size
sources.quote: The evergreen fund will invest initially between €1m and €3m in companies at series A stage... It aims to have between 15 and 20 companies in its portfolio over time.

strategy.thesis: Corporate investment unit of Sartorius, the German bioprocessing and lab-technology group, taking minority equity stakes in early-stage life-science-tools and bioanalytics start-ups that extend its instrumentation and consumables portfolio.

summary.en: Sartorius Ventures is the corporate investment unit of life-science-tools group Sartorius, taking minority stakes in early-stage bioanalytics start-ups such as SPARTA Biodiscovery (up to GBP 3.5M for a nanoparticle-analysis platform).

sources.title: Sartorius forms partnership with SPARTA Biodiscovery on novel nanoparticle analysis platform
sources.supports: existence of Sartorius Ventures unit, investment amount
sources.quote: Sartorius Ventures invested up to 3.5 million British pounds in a minority shareholding in SPARTA Biodiscovery.

sources.title: Sartorius Portfolio Investments
sources.quote: Sartorius has made 4 investments, with their latest investment being in Sparta Biodiscovery as part of a Seed round on September 28, 2023.

verification_notes: Sartorius does not maintain a prominent public-facing 'Sartorius Ventures' portal; existence and deal terms are confirmed via a corporate-news press release and third-party investor trackers. Sartorius also sponsors the separate 'Life Science Factory' startup incubator/co-working space (not counted as its CVC).

strategy.thesis: Deep-tech corporate venture arm of Carl Zeiss AG investing at pre-Series A/Series A into MedTech & Life Sciences start-ups (AI diagnostics, microscopy, ophthalmology, surgical robotics) alongside photonics/optics and industrial-tech deals, leveraging ZEISS's ophthalmic-device and microscopy franchises (incl. Carl Zeiss Meditec).

summary.en: ZEISS Ventures is Carl Zeiss AG's deep-tech corporate venture arm, writing €0.5–5M pre-Series A/Series A checks into MedTech & Life Sciences start-ups spanning ophthalmology, microscopy and surgical robotics, alongside photonics and industrial-tech deals.

sources.title: ZEISS Ventures
sources.quote: ZEISS Ventures is a Deep Tech investor with particular interest in Industrial Tech, Med Tech and Life Sciences... typical ticket sizes between 500k – 5 million Euros for initial investments.

sources.title: ZEISS leads funding round for Surgify Medical to drive safety in surgical procedures
sources.quote: ZEISS Ventures led a EUR 7 million Series A funding round for Surgify Medical, with participation from Lednil, Cascara Ventures and the European Innovation Council Fund.

strategy.thesis: French in vitro diagnostics leader bioMérieux makes direct corporate strategic equity investments in diagnostics and adjacent life-science-tools start-ups (e.g. Oxford Nanopore, Quanterix, Allergen Alert, Proxim Diagnostics) to access next-generation sequencing, sepsis-diagnostics and allergen-testing technology, and also invests via an internal intrapreneurship program.

summary.en: bioMérieux, the French in vitro diagnostics group, makes direct corporate strategic investments in diagnostics and life-science-tools start-ups — including a GBP70M stake in Oxford Nanopore and backing for sepsis/allergen-testing start-ups — rather than through one single named CVC fund.

sources.title: bioMérieux makes strategic investment in Oxford Nanopore
sources.supports: notable investment, existence of direct strategic investing

sources.title: bioMérieux invests in Allergen Alert, a startup resulting from its intrapreneurship program

verification_notes: bioMérieux does not brand a single named CVC fund; strategic equity investments are made directly by the corporate group (and via its intrapreneurship program). Distinct from Mérieux Partners / Mérieux Innovation, family-office-style funds of parent Institut Mérieux group, which were flagged but not independently verified as in-scope within this research pass.

strategy.thesis: Evergreen investment company wholly owned by the charitable William Demant Foundation, holding majority stakes in medtech operating businesses (Demant hearing-care/diagnostics group, Embla Medical, Vision RT) and significant minority stakes in adjacent medtech/healthtech companies (Vitrolife, CellaVision, Revenio, Invisio, GN Store Nord); functions as the strategic corporate investment arm for the Demant medtech group.

summary.en: William Demant Invest is the Denmark-based, foundation-owned evergreen holding and investment company behind the Demant hearing-care/diagnostics group, holding majority stakes in medtech operating businesses (Demant, Vision RT) and minority stakes in medtech peers such as Vitrolife and CellaVision.

sources.title: William Demant Invest A/S
sources.quote: William Demant Invest is a highly respected evergreen investment company, wholly owned by the charitable William Demant Foundation and the holding company for William Demant Foundation's investment activities.

sources.title: William Demant Invest Acquires Majority Shareholding in Vision RT

verification_notes: Structured as a charitable-foundation-owned holding/investment company rather than a classic single-operating-company CVC arm; included because it functions as the strategic investment vehicle for the Demant medtech (hearing-care and diagnostic equipment) group and actively invests in adjacent medtech/diagnostics companies.
